title: Branch-Resolved Characterization of Feed-Forward Error in Dynamic Teleportation via Classical Choi Shadows
summary: Mid-circuit measurement and classical feed-forward are essential primitives for dynamic-circuit teleportation on superconducting quantum processors. However, the error associated with measurement-conditioned corrective operations remains poorly understood when evaluated with respect to individual measurement branches. In this paper, we present a framework for characterizing feed-forward error in dynamic circuit teleportation without losing valuable information related to its behavior across separate branches.
